name: Administrator creates linked academic structure
description: Creates linked academic records and verifies they remain available after refresh.
steps: Sign in as an Administrator or Super Admin
Open Academic administration
Create a faculty, department, programme and course in sequence
Refresh the module and verify the records remain listed
expected: All linked academic records remain visible after refresh; invalid parent references are rejected.

name: Lecturer publishes an announcement to a selected audience
description: Verifies a lecturer can publish an announcement for a selected audience and that the announcement persists.
steps: Sign in as a Lecturer
Open Announcements
Publish a titled message for Students
Refresh the announcement board
expected: The published announcement appears in the lecturer's view and is delivered only to the selected audience.

name: Student views announcements for their audience
description: Verifies students can read announcements addressed to all users or students but not staff-only updates.
steps: Sign in as a Student
Open Announcements
Review visible campus updates
expected: Only published announcements for Everyone or Students are visible.

name: Student scans QR and checks in within the configured geofence
description: Verifies a location-required session accepts a student inside the lecturer-configured radius and rejects missing or out-of-range location fixes.
steps: Sign in as a Lecturer and create a session with classroom geofencing enabled
Capture the classroom coordinates and display the QR code
Sign in as a Student inside the configured area and share device location
Scan the QR and submit attendance
Repeat from outside the configured radius
expected: A valid in-range check-in is stored as Pending Verification; missing, inaccurate or out-of-range coordinates are rejected.

name: Attendance reports respect role boundaries and export a CSV file
description: Verifies students see only their own records, lecturers see records for their sessions, administrators see institutional records and users can export visible rows to CSV.
steps: Sign in as a user and open Attendance reports
Review the summary and course breakdown
Export CSV
Open the downloaded CSV and compare its rows with the visible report
expected: The report is scoped to the signed-in user's role and the CSV contains the same visible records and status fields.
